title: Just the Road
style: Soft rock with country delivery, mid-tempo steady 4/4 groove, warm acoustic guitar strums with restrained electric guitar fills, rounded bass and natural drums, intimate conversational male lead vocal with subtle country phrasing, clear narrative verses that build into a memorable open-hearted chorus, understated organ support, polished but organic studio mix, reflective and road-worn mood.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Claire caught the next flight back to London
Fernando had cousins down in Houston town
So I took the wheel of a rented RAV4
GPS blinking, trying to find my way around
Dallas came up mile by mile
A new town, a long way from home

[Verse 2]
Amanda knew the streets and the places
David Brown’s assistant, kind enough to show
Most nights she was there beside me
While the Texas evening settled in slow
Then Bob called from near Wichita Falls
Said, “Come see the ranch this weekend, friend”

[Chorus]
I kept moving, town to town
Looking for a reason to stay
Some doors opened, some stayed closed
Some good nights just slipped away
There were names I held close, miles I drove through
And a message that said, “I thought of you”
No grand promise, no sure thing
Just the road and what it brings

[Verse 3]
Amanda came along to meet Bob
We got separate rooms at the ranch
His sister-in-law crossed my line of sight
One small spark, then no second chance
She wasn’t looking my way at all
I learned to let that moment pass

[Verse 4]
Next week Austin, on my own
After meetings, I tried the bar
One offer came and went unanswered
Nothing there worth taking that far
Back at the hotel, I asked the ceiling
If this trip was what I’d hoped to find

[Pre-Chorus]
The woman on the plane, the doctor too
The nights that ended just the same
Gabi mattered, Amanda mattered
Diana crossed my mind again

[Chorus]
I kept moving, town to town
Looking for a reason to stay
Some doors opened, some stayed closed
Some good nights just slipped away
There were names I held close, miles I drove through
And a message that said, “I thought of you”
No grand promise, no sure thing
Just the road and what it brings

[Bridge]
Europe waking, or North Africa
I sent a sticker, nothing more
Just a little sign I remembered
Not a knock upon her door
She answered in a few short minutes
No new words to draw me in
Some connections live in silence
Some are still worth holding in

[Verse 5]
Back to Dallas, back to Amanda
Till New York called me out of town
No promises between us, only
“If you’re back, you can reach me now”
So I drove beneath that wide Texas sky
With the next departure on my mind

[Final Chorus]
I kept moving, town to town
Never sure what I would find
Some doors opened, some stayed closed
Some stayed with me down the line
There were names I held close, miles I drove through
And a message that said, “I thought of you”
No grand promise, no sure thing
Just the road and what it brings

[Outro]
Claire flew home, the miles rolled on
Dallas fading in the rearview dawn
